resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Verify a round-two record's prior against the first-round record
body:
Outcome: the trusted verifier of a round-two review record (review admission and krn ship) recomputes the record's prior (source, findings, changedPaths, checklist digest) from the first-round record named by attempt.priorRecordSha256 and refuses a mismatch. Today only the schema is checked, so an edited round-two record can zero or relabel prior findings (panel or prepass source) and still validate. Observer red at base.
Evidence: PR #170 review attempt 3 prepass finding 1 (.krn/runs/review-series/2f4a3e69d97729450ec55e516b77cbf5f58f7afa3565aa0ce322437c1ebe3b6d/records/3.json); git grep shows recordSha256 only written (src/flow/prior.ts, src/flow/series.ts), never compared.
